subject: prd/self-drive-wake
statement: If a read returns data the schema cannot parse (platform API drift), then the system shall surface a named defect distinguishing "broken" from "empty" — an unparseable response is never presented as a healthy zero-state
intent: a typed error row / non-clean exit, naming the parse failure
fit_criterion: malformed-response fixtures produce the named defect; no fixture renders as an empty-but-healthy list
